subject: general
question: Under which mission is MeitY collaborating with IITs for semiconductor skill development?

options.text: Modified Programme for Semiconductors and Display Fab

solution:
The correct answer is __**India Semiconductor Mission.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **MeitY is collaborating with IITs and private colleges under the India Semiconductor Mission to train professionals for the growing semiconductor sector in India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The mission focuses on developing local expertise in semiconductor manufacturing and related materials.**
 
• **Training programs will cover specialty materials, gases, substrates, and equipment used in the semiconductor ecosystem.**
 
• **Overseas training opportunities will be provided to address skill gaps and enhance capabilities.**
 
• **This initiative aims to strengthen India’s position in the global semiconductor industry.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• India Semiconductor Mission__

 __
 
• Launched to promote domestic semiconductor manufacturing and create a robust ecosystem.
 
• Focuses on infrastructure development, research, and skilling initiatives to boost the industry.
 
 
 
• Importance of Semiconductor Sector__
 __
 
• Semiconductors are critical for various industries, including electronics, automotive, and telecommunications.
 
• Developing local manufacturing capabilities will reduce dependency on imports and strengthen India's technological independence.
 
 
 
• Role of Training Programs__
 
 
• Skilled professionals are essential for operating advanced manufacturing facilities.
 
• Training programs ensure the availability of expertise in materials, equipment, and processes.
